title: Day 25/28 - HCP Terraform Explained - Terraform Cloud Tutorial
description:
Terraform Cloud Tutorial: HCP Terraform Explained

Dive deep into HashiCorp Cloud Platform (HCP) Terraform in this comprehensive tutorial! Learn how Terraform Cloud differs from the CLI version and discover powerful collaboration features for your infrastructure as code workflows. This video covers organization hierarchies, workspaces vs projects, and includes step-by-step demonstrations of both version control and CLI-based workflows.

What You'll Learn:
The core differences between Terraform Cloud and Terraform CLI
How to structure your organization within HCP Terraform
Understanding workspaces and projects in Terraform Cloud
The complete Terraform Cloud workflow explained
Practical demos for setting up version control integration
How to implement CLI-based workflows with Terraform Cloud

Perfect for DevOps engineers, cloud architects, and anyone looking to scale their Terraform practices across teams. Whether you're managing small projects or enterprise infrastructure, this tutorial will help you leverage the full power of HCP Terraform.

Subscribe for more infrastructure as code and cloud automation tutorials!
